# Markdown normalization app

## Summary

Normalize deterministic Markdown documents through an AgentMesh App.

## Problem

Markdown tools currently need orchestrator-specific glue and duplicate parsing.

## Desired capability

Add a fixture-driven Markdown normalization App without Multica domain types.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Manifest validates through pinned CLI.
- [ ] Fixtures produce deterministic output.

## Evidence

- AgentMesh roadmap requests a non-Multica Markdown App.

## User story

- As a tool author, I can invoke one pinned Markdown App from different orchestrators.
